record.title: Passport photograph
record.details: MRP photograph meeting the immigration photograph requirements specified in the supplied checklist.

details: MRP photograph meeting immigration photograph requirements.

record.title: Police report
record.details: The supplied checklist requests a valid police report no more than 3 months old.

details: Provide a valid police report no more than 3 months old.

record.title: Handwritten Statement of Purpose
record.details: The supplied checklist requests an SOP handwritten by the student personally.

details: Provide an SOP handwritten by the student personally.

record.title: Pre-medical examination evidence
record.details: The supplied checklist states that the examination must be performed after the offer and submitted with the visa application. It lists Norvic, TMMC, Nepal Mendicity and IOM as providers.

details: Complete the examination after receiving the offer and submit the results with the visa application. Providers include Norvic, TMMC, Nepal Mendicity and IOM.

record.title: Loan sanction letter and mortgage deed
record.details: Submit with the visa application for loan-funded cases. The supplied checklist specifies Nabil or Nepal SBI Bank.

details: Submit a loan sanction letter and mortgage deed from Nabil or Nepal SBI Bank with the visa application for loan-funded cases.

record.title: Funds and liquid savings evidence
record.details: The supplied checklist states 60 lakhs and around 10 lakhs in liquid funds, with evidence of relevant sources. It does not specify the currency in this line.

details: Provide evidence of 60 lakhs in funds and around 10 lakhs in liquid funds, including evidence of the relevant funding sources. Currency is unspecified.

record.title: Sponsor relationship verification and citizenship
record.details: Provide relationship verification documents and sponsors’ citizenship certificates. The supplied checklist specifies immediate family members and siblings as sponsors.

details: Provide relationship verification documents and sponsors’ citizenship certificates. Sponsors should be immediate family members or siblings.

record.title: Form INZ 1226
record.details: Provide Form INZ 1226 as listed in the supplied checklist.

record.title: Income certificate
record.details: Provide an income certificate from the ward, with supporting evidence for the applicable income sources below.

details: Provide an income certificate from the ward, with supporting evidence for the applicable income sources.

record.title: Business income evidence (if applicable)
record.details: PAN, renewed business registration, TDS for 3 years, statements and an audit report from an authorised auditor. The supplied checklist describes the auditor as authorised in IRRC.

details: Provide PAN, renewed business registration, TDS for 3 years, statements and an audit report from an auditor authorised in IRRC.

record.title: Agricultural income evidence (if applicable)
record.details: Ward certificate with tax exemption and supporting documents. The supplied checklist states agricultural income must be below 4 lakhs; it does not specify the currency or period in this line.

details: Provide a ward certificate with tax exemption and supporting documents. Agricultural income must be below 4 lakhs; currency and period are unspecified.

record.title: Clarification and declaration letters (if requested)
record.details: Provide clarification or declaration letters and supporting evidence when requested to satisfy the visa officer. The supplied checklist notes that submitted documents may be digitally verified or investigated for authenticity.

details: Provide clarification or declaration letters and supporting evidence when requested to satisfy the visa officer. Submitted documents may be digitally verified or investigated for authenticity.

record.title: Fee payment proof after Approval in Principle
record.details: After receiving Approval in Principle (AIP), transfer funds to the education provider as invoiced and provide payment proof. The supplied checklist says the funds should come from the same original funding source: loan funds for a loan case or bank balance for a balance-funded case. It states payment proof is usually requested within 7 days.

details: After receiving Approval in Principle (AIP), transfer funds to the education provider as invoiced and provide payment proof. Use the same original funding source: loan funds for a loan case or bank balance for a balance-funded case. Payment proof is usually requested within 7 days.
